children: The average transaction price for a new vehicle in the U.S. had a small increase in September, marking the fourth consecutive month of increases and landing just below the all-time high, Kelley Blue Book says. The September average transaction price was $50,562, while the all-time record of $50,614 was set in December, the Cox Automotive brand says. The year-over-year increase in September was below 1%, while the month historically sees gains of 2% to 4%, according to Kelley Blue Book. Erin Keating, Executive Analyst, Cox Automotive, says, "Affordability pressures are pushing more buyers toward lower-priced vehicles and segments, which tempers the industrywide number even as prices for individual vehicles rise." (stephen.nakrosis@wsj.com)
